userStories.description: As a developer with duplicates differing only in generic type arguments (List<T> vs Dictionary<T>, IEnumerable<T> vs IAsyncEnumerable<T>), I want rt refactor extract-method --replace-duplicates to detect type-parameter variations and generate generic methods so that I can consolidate ~10-15 additional duplicate groups.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze the ~10-15 type-parameter-blocked groups in tasks/us-032-duplicate-types.md and identify generic patterns (List<T> vs Dict<T>, sync vs async collections, different generic constraints)
Design GenericParameterDetector to identify type-positions that vary across duplicates and propose generic type parameter names (T, TKey, TValue, etc.)
Generate generic method signature: TResult MethodName<T, TKey>(List<T> input, ...) where constraints match the extracted pattern
Implement constraint inference: detect use of generic methods/properties and infer necessary where clauses (T : IEnumerable, etc.)
Extend call sites to pass type arguments: MethodName<int>(intList, ...) or MethodName<string, object>(dict, ...)
Add xUnit tests: single type parameter, multiple type parameters with constraints, nested generics
Verify ~10-15 roslyn-tools groups now become extractable
dotnet build, dotnet test, dotnet format all pass
userStories.notes: High complexity: constraint inference and type-parameter-position detection require careful semantic analysis. Build on Phase 1-4 infrastructure. Dogfood: test against real codebases with collection/LINQ duplicate groups.
